page.overview:
Who is Drelmar Bin?

Drelmar Bin was a male Human who lived on the planet Korbin during the early years of the New Republic. Originally a corporate employee on an industrial planet, Bin fled when it was discovered that he had been embezzling. On Korbin, he met a man who had perfected a technique of distilling kyrf fruit into an alcoholic beverage. Bin killed the man and took over his plantation.
